Composite release manifest

Source: R/release_manifest.R
release_manifest.Rd

Collects the versions that determine a result: R, the curveR packages, CmdStan (when cmdstanr and an installation are available), the calib schema version, the hash of an renv lockfile, and whatever the caller adds (the component's own name, version and commit). The worker stores it with every job in calib_run.manifest; apps show it and attach it to downloads.

Usage

release_manifest(
  component = NA_character_,
  version = NA_character_,
  commit = NA_character_,
  packages = c("curveRcore", "curveRfreq", "curveRbayes", "curveRweights"),
  cmdstan = TRUE,
  lockfile = NULL,
  extra = list()
)

Arguments

component

Optional name of the component building the manifest, e.g. "i-spi-compute-worker" or "i-spi".

version

Optional version of that component (e.g. its image tag).

commit

Optional commit (git SHA) of that component.

packages

Packages whose installed versions are recorded (NA when not installed).

cmdstan

Logical: try to record the CmdStan version through cmdstanr.

lockfile

Optional path to an renv.lock; its MD5 is recorded.

extra

Optional named list of further entries (scalars or named lists).

Value

A named list with entries manifest_version, created_at (UTC, ISO 8601), component, version, commit, r_version, platform, packages (named list), cmdstan, calib_schema, renv_lock_md5, and the entries of extra. Serialise with manifest_json().

See also

manifest_json(), calib_schema_version()

Examples

m <- release_manifest("example", "1.0.0", cmdstan = FALSE)
m$calib_schema
#> [1] "0.7.1"
cat(manifest_json(m))
#> {"manifest_version":1,"created_at":"2026-11-28T11:50:58Z","component":"example","version":"1.0.0","commit":null,"r_version":"4.6.2","platform":"x86_64-pc-linux-gnu","packages":{"curveRcore":"0.8.0","curveRfreq":null,"curveRbayes":null,"curveRweights":null},"cmdstan":null,"calib_schema":"0.7.1","renv_lock_md5":null}
